/story.title: Our Story | Ugly Donuts & Corn Dogs (어글리)
/story.meta: How Ugly Donuts & Corn Dogs (어글리) started serving made-to-order hot donuts and Korean corn dogs fried in avocado oil.
/story.intro: Ugly Donuts & Corn Dogs (어글리) was founded by John Kim, who remembers his mother buying him a corn dog in Korea about 30 years ago. The Korean corn dog traces its heritage to the Korean War when American troops shared corn dogs, leading to a Korean version made with rice flour batter and mozzarella. Today, we honor that history by serving fresh Korean corn dogs and handmade hot donuts.
